# IR35Careers

> UK contract opportunities with evidence-based IR35 status, rates and contractor tools.

## Public pages
- [Contract search](https://www.ir35careers.com/jobs): Listings and filters. Availability is not guaranteed; check the original posting.
- [Contract categories](https://www.ir35careers.com/contracts): Browse by skill, location and IR35 status.
- [IR35 status tool](https://www.ir35careers.com/tools/ir35-status): Educational guidance, not a legal determination.
- [Take-home calculator](https://www.ir35careers.com/tools/take-home): Estimates, not financial advice.
- [Research](https://www.ir35careers.com/blog): Contractor guides.
- [Privacy](https://www.ir35careers.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://www.ir35careers.com/terms)
- [Sitemap](https://www.ir35careers.com/sitemap.xml)

## Boundaries
Account, dashboard, inbox, applications, CVs, admin and API routes are private. Do not crawl or reproduce personal information. Do not infer an employer endorsement, salary, IR35 determination or successful submission from a listing. AI-assisted applications require contractor approval; this file grants no automation permission.
